text:
Sophie: quick async check — trying to onboard zeta-7b-v2 weights for the staging registry. I pulled the HF link from the model card but the tokenizer fails during serve smoke with 'vocab size mismatch'. Anyone know which artifact we should be mirroring? :eyes:
Raj: I grabbed the weights yesterday: hf://redwood/zeta-7b-v2/commit/ab12cd34 — but the tokenizer there is `tokenizer.json` + merges, might be a different vocab ordering. Did you use the `--tokenizer-from` override?
Sophie: nope, I just pointed the serving manifest at the S3 copies (we mirrored with the old script). Getting `ValueError: expected vocab_size 50257 but found 50000` during model init.
Dmitri: that usually means HF upload used SentencePiece vs. byte-level BPE mismatch. Check `tokenizer_config.json` in the repo; sometimes HF stores `tokenizer.json` that conflates multiple formats.
Elaine: Sophie — can you paste the top of your manifest.json (safe fields only)? I'll lint it quickly.
Sophie: here (trimmed):
```
{
  "model": "zeta-7b-v2",
  "weights": "s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/zeta/7b/v2/weights.pt",
  "tokenizer": "s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/zeta/7b/v2/tokenizer/tokenizer.json",
  "checksum": "sha256:TODO",
  "origin": "hf://redwood/zeta-7b-v2@ab12cd34"
}
```
Mike: iirc our mirror script didn't copy `tokenizer.model` for sentencepiece uploads, only `tokenizer.json`. If HF model uses spm it needs `.model` binary and `tokenizer_config.json` with `model_max_length` etc.
Sophie: argh, that explains it. Can someone confirm whether the HF origin has `tokenizer.model`?
Raj: checking now... give me a sec.
infra-bot: [artifact-mirror] start mirror job 7821 -> s3://redwood-artifacts/staging/zeta-7b-v2 (presign generation queued)
Raj: confirmed — HF origin includes `tokenizer.model` and `tokenizer_config.json`. Our mirror script filtered it out because of the `.model` suffix rule.
Dmitri: we should update the mirror rule to whitelist `.model` and `.spm` and also copy `tokenizer_config.json`. I'll open a quick PR to eng-infra. Ping me for CR.
Elaine: also add a post-mirror validation step that runs `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')"` and compares `len(tokenizer.get_vocab())` to declared `vocab_size` in `tokenizer_config.json`. Fails should flag the artifact as invalid.
Sophie: that validation would save so much time. For now, can someone re-run a one-off mirror to staging with the tokenizer binary? I need to smoke serve tonight.
Raj: I started a manual copy: `aws s3 cp s3://hf-redwood/zeta-7b-v2/tokenizer.model s3://redwood-artifacts/staging/zeta-7b-v2/tokenizer/tokenizer.model` — will set ACL to private and attach origin metadata.
infra-bot: [presign] artifact s3://redwood-artifacts/staging/zeta-7b-v2/tokenizer/tokenizer.model -> https://presign.redwood/s/abc123 (ttl=1h) :lock:
Mike: Sophie, use this presign to pull into your dev instance and retest. Also update `manifest.checksum` with `sha256sum tokenizer.model` output once mirror finishes.
Sophie: pulling now, thanks.
Sophie: quick note — after loading tokenizer.model the serve smoke got past vocab error but now hits a config mismatch: `expected eos_token_id but found null`. I think `tokenizer_config.json` in S3 is empty/trimmed.
Raj: looks like our mirror pipeline strips unknown fields. I'll include a pass-through for `tokenizer_config.json` and `special_tokens_map.json`. Pushing change to mirrorer branch, will run a rebuild job.
Dmitri: PR opened: github.com/redwood/eng-infra/pull/218 — changes mirror whitelist and adds validation script. @Elaine can you review the validation tests?
Elaine: on it, will review today. If we want fast rollback we should also add a fallback policy in the serving manifest: `fallback_model: zeta-7b-v1` so can keep uptime during mirror flaps.
Sophie: good call, adding fallback for the rollout. Also leaving a TODO to update `registry` to index both tokenizer variants with checksums.
Mike: FYI security flagged presign usage — make sure presigned links are single-use and limited TTL. infra-bot indicated ttl=1h which is ok but we should rotate the presign after mirror completes.
Sophie: thanks everyone — will re-run smoke and post results here. If all green I'll ping eng-release for a canary. :shipit:
